title: Injectivity of hybrid coordinate selection
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $r$, the map from the $n$-coordinate set to the disjoint union of two copies of that set, sending $i$ to the right copy when $i<r$ and to the left copy otherwise, is injective.
replaced: For integers $n,r\ge0$, the map sending $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to its right copy when $i<r$ and its left copy otherwise is injective.
